lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible across the mid-flank, posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a regular, repeating 2D grid pattern with relatively uniform inter-centroid spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, particularly in the central and posterior sections of the flank, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a distinct lattice-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal-facing edge to shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Aggregation of numerous small, dark, fusiform shapes (consistent with commensal fish) localized primarily around the pectoral fin and lower lateral flank.
